upstream_note: The assigned registry name 'red_bull' maps to the Red Bull consumer site at https://www.redbull.com/ (us-en). The literal hostname red_bull.com does not resolve in DNS (underscore hostnames are not valid); www.redbull.com is the real upstream this mirror captures.
capture_method: direct HTTP fetches with a coherent Safari header set against the server-rendered pages (the upstream is behind Akamai bot management; plain default-header requests are refused) plus the public redbull.com JSON content API (/v3/api/graphql/v1/v3/...) for the client-rendered surfaces (event pages, feeds), headless Chromium (Playwright) to discover the exact API endpoints the live pages call, and the public Shopify products.json endpoint for the shop catalog

www.redbull.com.role: primary site: home, energy-drink catalog and product pages, events calendar, event Info/Schedule/FAQs pages, event-series hubs, athletes hub and profiles, stories, films & shows catalog, site chrome (nav, logo, favicon)
www.redbull.com.pages_detail: 18 product pages, 100 event detail records (57 with Schedule/FAQs tab content), 5 event-series pages, 60 athlete profiles, 40 story pages
www.redbull.com.content_api: /v3/api/graphql/v1/v3/feed and /v3/query endpoints (events, athletes, films, shows, episode-videos, stories, countries aggregates)

participate.redbull.com.role: Red Bull participation/ticketing API: registration records for the events with open registrations (entry fees, ticket type names, free vs paid)

img.redbull.com.role: Red Bull image CDN (cloudinary): event, athlete, film, show, story, series and product imagery at the URLs the live pages render

www.redbullshopus.com.role: Red Bull Shop US (Shopify), linked from the redbull.com footer: product catalog via the public products.json endpoint (titles, vendors, product types, tags, variants with sizes/SKUs/prices, descriptions)

cdn.shopify.com.role: Shopify CDN: shop product images at the URLs the product records reference (fetched at width=800)

images.policy: every file fetched from the upstream URL it renders at; no placeholders, no duplicates, no stretching. Events that share one upstream image (e.g. the two Red Bull Wings Cup stops) reuse the same file exactly like the upstream renders the same asset; per-file sha256 and source URL in asset_inventory.json

benchmark_users.fixture: one shipped shop order (FC Red Bull Salzburg Embossed Hoodie), two confirmed event registrations (Foam Wreckers Virginia Beach RB7F3A21, Rapid Release RB9C04D7), three favorites (event, film, athlete)
one confirmed registration (Barn Find Open RB2B8E90), three favorites (story, show, event)
clean account (no orders, registrations or favorites) for fresh flows

fixtures.benchmark_state: shop orders, event registration codes, and favorites are deterministic benchmark fixtures keyed to the benchmark users; all catalog, event, athlete, film, show, story and shop data is upstream-sourced
fixtures.deterministic_seed: the SQLite seed is materialized at image build time with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 and a frozen bcrypt benchmark password; three fresh builds produce a byte-identical database and re-running the seed against a populated database is a no-op
fixtures.mirror_date: 2026-09-30 — the frozen snapshot date the site's upcoming/past logic is anchored to

functional_domains: event calendar browsing with discipline/country/time filters and pagination
event registration with validation, real upstream entry fees and confirmation codes
energy-drink catalog with product-line filters, ingredient/nutrition facts and can sizes
athlete directory with nationality/discipline/A-Z filters and profile facts
films and shows catalogs with discipline filters, pagination, season/episode tables
story listing with topic filters and full article bodies
shop catalog with category/brand/price filters, size variants, SKUs, cart, checkout and orders
account surface: login, orders, registrations, favorites management
task_surface.honest_steps: two independent Playwright audits (visible-element interaction only, reads excluded, no padding): 332 atomic actions total, min 15 per task, max 23, identical between runs
